name: nova-prettier-extension
author: Toni Förster
description: Prettier integration for Nova – format JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, CSS, HTML, Markdown, and more, with built-in support for Java, PHP, Shell, SQL, and XML – no extra setup required.

scripts.clean: rm -f prettier.novaextension/config.json prettier.novaextension/configWorkspace.json && rm -rf prettier.novaextension/de.lproj prettier.novaextension/en.lproj prettier.novaextension/node_modules prettier.novaextension/Scripts
scripts.test:setup: npm run build && npm install --omit=dev --prefix prettier.novaextension
scripts.test: npm run test:setup && npm run test:sql && npm run test:install-lock && npm run test:watcher-filter && npm run test:resolver-guard && npm run test:notifications && npm run test:restart-cycle && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:prettier-info && npm run test:service && npm run test:external-plugins
